prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished high-fidelity desktop NATIVE enterprise messenger interface design for surreal_ck, whose current consumer brand is 吉吉 / Workspace. One single full app screenshot, flat front-on, 16:10 landscape, crisp Chinese UI text, no device frame, no perspective, no marketing headline outside app. Calm warm white #faf9f6, ink #161513, restrained golden yellow #f5c542 accents, thin warm-gray separators, 8px radius, comfortable compact density. Native macOS titlebar traffic lights, small title 吉吉 · 团队协同. Brand mark: tiny black rounded square with gold grid and subtle black cat silhouette, do not use generic green sprout. Left 68px slim rail contains workspace monogram, message icon selected gold, video meeting icon, contacts icon, bottom profile and settings. Second pane width 290px title 消息 with search 搜索成员或消息, filter 全部 / 未读 / 群聊, six elegant conversation rows with muted colored initial avatars, selected 产品设计组, unread count 3. Other conversations 林晓 / 工程讨论 / 陈默 / 全员交流 / 设计评审. Main large chat pane title 产品设计组 with subtitle 8 位成员 · 5 人在线; upper-right audio call, video call, members icons. A very slim pinned strip 本周目标：完成协同端体验评审. Render realistic readable Chinese conversation with avatar initials and timestamps, generous whitespace, NO kanban NO charts NO AI agents. 林晓 10:24: 新版聊天和会议的设计稿准备好了，大家一起看一下。 陈默 10:25: 我先确认一下，屏幕共享可以只选一个窗口吗？ outgoing light warm-yellow bubble: 可以，只共享选中的窗口，其他内容不会展示。 A compact shared file card 协同端设计稿.pdf / 2.4 MB · 6 页. A restrained inline live meeting card with small gold video icon: 设计走查 / 3 人正在会议中 / 加入会议. Bottom compose area with line 输入消息，Enter 发送, toolbar attach/smile, gold square send button and faint 已读 5 人. A very subtle right edge member avatars in header only, no extra bulky dashboard sidebar. Professional typography comparable SF Pro / PingFang SC, accurate hierarchy, beautiful quiet enterprise software. All people and messages fictional. Design-only concept, not claimed as existing functionality.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a matching second high fidelity native desktop UI design for 吉吉 · 团队协同 (surreal_ck). Reference image is the approved STYLE reference only, not a pixel edit target: inherit warm black/golden yellow minimal brand, precise Chinese typography and native titlebar. Single flat full screenshot 16:10 landscape, no device frame. This screen is an active video meeting with shared screen, not messenger. Charcoal #161513 meeting canvas, warm-white text, refined gold #f5c542 active borders, subdued gray controls, no purple or neon. Header traffic lights left and title 设计走查, understated connection icon 网络良好 and timer 18:42, top right layout icon and 全屏. Large left 75% shared content area: slim label 林晓正在共享 · 协同端设计稿, beneath a realistically scaled design presentation slide on warm white with title 让沟通回到事情本身, three small clean preview cards captioned 消息 / 会议 / 屏幕共享, and small 吉吉 wordmark. This is a mock presentation, no complicated diagrams. Right 25% vertical stack of four equal video tiles, photorealistic fictional Chinese adult coworkers in softly lit offices, varied headshots, name labels 林晓 / 陈默 / 王磊 / 我. First tile gold thin active speaker border, small waveform, others muted microphone status. Bottom native meeting controls centered as tidy rounded dark buttons with clear icons and Chinese labels 麦克风 / 摄像头 / 共享屏幕 / 参会人 4 / 聊天; selected share button restrained gold. Separate far-right coral red 离开会议 button. Add only a tiny toast top center 仅共享选中的窗口, no recording button, no AI assistant, no calendar, no transcripts. Premium understated enterprise product, exact crisp readable Chinese text, coherent alignments. Design-only concept.

Use case: ui-mockup. Third matching high fidelity native desktop interface for 吉吉 · 团队协同 (surreal_ck). Input is STYLE reference only. Single flat front-on landscape 16:10 app screenshot. Warm-white #faf9f6 native app, charcoal typography #161513, restrained gold #f5c542, crisp Chinese SF Pro/PingFang style. Show screen-sharing source picker dialog centered in a gently dimmed native meeting window. Background meeting visible with four muted dark portrait placeholder tiles and a bottom control bar, no real faces needed. Native modal width about 850px and height 650px, carefully spacious layout, warm-white surface, fine border and small radius. Modal title 选择要共享的内容, subtitle 仅向会议成员展示所选内容, top right small close X. Segmented control 窗口 (selected pale gold) / 整个屏幕. Four rectangular source thumbnail cards in a 2 by 2 grid: selected top-left 协同端设计稿 · 预览 with tasteful mini gold slide, crisp gold border and checkmark; top-right 产品讨论 · 吉吉 with miniature messenger; bottom-left 方案文档 · 编辑器 with text lines; bottom-right 项目看板 · 浏览器 with restrained table. Under grid small amber privacy notice 共享整个屏幕时，通知和其他窗口可能被看到。 Bottom row left unchecked checkbox 同时共享系统音频 and helper text 取决于系统支持; bottom right neutral 取消 and gold 开始共享 primary button. Small secondary link 查看屏幕录制权限 above footer, not an enabled permission claim. Main screen header visible 设计走查 · 4 人, bottom meeting bar has muted mic, camera, share icons, separate red leave button. No web browser chrome, no dashboard, no recording, no AI. Make every major Chinese string legible and accurate; polished native desktop software, not a poster.
